ar.title: كيكة الفواكه بالكراميل

steps.n1: يضرب البيض في المضرب الكهربائي ثم السكر ثم الزيت أو السمن السايح ثم العصير وبشر الليمون أو البرتقال والفانيليا.
steps.n2: بعد ذوبان السكر نضيف الدقيق تدريجيا حتى يختلط تماما.
steps.n3: نضع عجينة الكيكة فوق الكراميل البارد باحتراس شديد.
steps.n4: تدخل فرن متوسط الحرارة حتى تنضج ويحمر الوجه.
steps.n5: بمجرد خروج الصينية من الفرن نعمل ثقوبا في الكيكة خفيفا بالشوكة.
steps.n6: نحضر طبق التقديم بنفس حجم الصينية ونضع الطبق فوق الكيكة ونقلبها باحتراس ونترك فوقها الصينية كغطاء حتى تتشرب الكيكة كل الكراميل.
steps.n7: بعد أن تبرد ممكن تجميلها بالمكسرات وجوز الهند.

en.title: Caramel Fruit Cake

steps.n1: Beat the eggs with an electric mixer, then add the sugar, followed by the oil or melted ghee, the juice, lemon or orange zest, and vanilla.
steps.n2: Once the sugar has dissolved, gradually add the flour until fully combined.
steps.n3: Carefully pour the cake batter over the cold caramel in the pan.
steps.n4: Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
steps.n5: As soon as the pan is removed from the oven, lightly prick holes in the cake with a fork.
steps.n6: Prepare a serving plate the same size as the pan, place the plate over the cake, and carefully flip them; leave the pan on top as a cover so the cake absorbs all the caramel.
steps.n7: Once cooled, you can garnish with nuts and coconut.

legacySteps: Beat the eggs with an electric mixer, then add the sugar, followed by the oil or melted ghee, the juice, lemon or orange zest, and vanilla.
Once the sugar has dissolved, gradually add the flour until fully combined.
Carefully pour the cake batter over the cold caramel in the pan.
Bake in a medium-heat oven until cooked through and the top is golden brown.
As soon as the pan is removed from the oven, lightly prick holes in the cake with a fork.
Prepare a serving plate the same size as the pan, place the plate over the cake, and carefully flip them; leave the pan on top as a cover so the cake absorbs all the caramel.
Once cooled, you can garnish with nuts and coconut.
